name: Chicken Marsala Skillet
note: Distinct named Italian-American dish; no chicken marsala and no marsala wine anywhere in the catalog. Borderline vs the already-accepted french-chicken-fricassee (both creamy-mushroom chicken-in-wine, no starch), but genuinely different dinners: sweet fortified marsala + quick sear-and-reduce skillet (Italian-American) vs dry-white velouté braise (French). Also distinct from creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet (sun-dried-tomato/spinach cream). Widens cuisine spread; carries one deliberate pricer-lane flag (marsala wine). Cross-lane check: no pork/turkey marsala twin exists in the accepted list; a same-dish-different-protein twin would only be a future-lane concern.
